read.thesis: Organic sales flat (0%) with volume down 1% and price up 1%; core EPS flat at $1.88 and FY26 guidance held except diluted EPS cut to 1-6% on restructuring, so no supply-side or capacity signal.

triggers.label: Organic volume down 1%
triggers.quote: a unit volume decline of one percent

triggers.label: Diluted EPS guide cut to 1-6%
triggers.quote: P&G adjusted its outlook for fiscal 2026 diluted net earnings per share growth to be in the range of one percent to six percent from prior guidance of three percent to nine percent

triggers.label: Gross margin down 120 bps on mix
triggers.quote: 120 basis points of unfavorable mix, 60 basis points of product reinvestments

guidance.quote: P&G maintained its guidance range for fiscal 2026 all-in sales growth to be in the range of one to five percent
The Company also maintained its outlook for organic sales growth in the range of in-line to up four percent
P&G adjusted its outlook for fiscal 2026 diluted net earnings per share growth to be in the range of one percent to six percent
P&G maintained its fiscal 2026 core earnings per share growth to be in the range of in-line to up four percent
P&G now expects commodity costs to be neutral for the year.
Capital spending is estimated to be in the range of four to five percent of fiscal 2026 net sales.
P&G continues to expect adjusted free cash flow productivity of 85% to 90%
